products.name: JX series jewellers weighing scale
products.description: When trading in gold and precious metals, accuracy is paramount. The Essae JX Series jewellery balance delivers precision weighing results, making it the trusted choice for jewellers, bullion traders, and gem specialists. Designed with ergonomics, durability, and ease of use, the JX Series combines performance with elegance. Powered by both an AC adapter and an inbuilt rechargeable lithium ion battery, the JX Series ensures uninterrupted productivity. Its dark violet LCD with a white backlight displays results in large 13 mm digits, ensuring clear visibility even in busy retail environments.

products.name: HT/HTR SERIES Analytical balance
products.description: The HT/HTR Series analytical weighing scale is built on the highly reliable tuning fork sensing technology, delivering unmatched accuracy and stability. With the option of an in built calibration weight, it offers versatile functions such as weighing, counting, percentage, unit conversion, and density measurement. Compact, safe, and energy efficient, it is ideal for QC, laboratory, and research scientists who demand precision and convenience.
products.features:
High accuracy and precision
Tuning Fork Technology ensures consistent results with minimal drift.

Compact and safe design
Simple structure with fewer parts enhances durability and safety.

Plug and perform convenience
Reduced warm up time by 90% for faster workflows

Multi mode functionality
Weighing, counting, unit conversion, and density measurement.

Optional In built calibration
Eliminates external calibration needs for hassle free operation.

products.name: AJ Series Precision balance
products.description: The AJ Series precision balance is designed for laboratories, jewellery businesses, and industrial applications where accuracy and reliability are non negotiable. Compact yet powerful, it combines advanced tuning fork sensor technology with user friendly features to deliver consistent results every time.
products.features:
High accuracy
With MMTS technology, it ensures precise measurements for laboratory experiments and jewellery weighing.

Ease of operation
Simple interface with clear display for quick, error free readings.

Versatile connectivity
Options to connect with computers or printers for seamless data management.

Rechargeable battery backup
With the optional rechargeable battery, you can carry the AJ Series anywhere you need perfect for mobile operations or environments where power access is limited.

Reliable support
Backed by Essae’s nationwide service and customer care network.

products.name: LF-225DR Semi micro balance
products.description: The Essae LF-225DR Semi micro balance is engineered for laboratories and industries that demand uncompromising precision. With an exceptional readability of 0.01 mg, this micro weight machine ensures reliable results for advanced research and analysis. Built on electro magnetic force compensation technology, the LF-225DR delivers superior stability, minimal temperature drift, and consistent performance compared to conventional balances. Compact yet robust, it is the ideal choice for pharma QC labs, chemical research, and material testing, where accuracy and repeatability are critical.
products.features:
High precision readability
0.01 mg resolution for micro level weighing.

Reliable technology
Electro magnetic force compensation ensures accuracy with low temperature drift.

User friendly design
Intuitive interface and ergonomic layout for smooth operation.

Versatile applications
Suitable for pharma QC, R&D labs, chemical analysis, and academic institutions.

Trusted Essae quality
Backed by calibration certificates and after sales support.

products.description: The GX-L High Capacity precision balances were designed for applications that require laboratory accuracy but with industrial protection. products.features:

This software is for users who wish to install the GX-L/GF-L balance in an automated weighing system and adjust its response settings beyond the standard settings.

Parameter setting software WinCT-ParamSet
This software can read and change the internal settings of an A&D electronic balance all at once.

Time & Date (GH models only)
Standard Time & Date Function complies with GLP and Interval Weighing in the Data Memory Function.
Interval Time Setting (GH models only)
Weighing intervals of 2, 5, 10, 30 seconds and 1, 2, 5, 10 minutes in the Data Memory Function

products.name: FX-i Series
products.description:
High Performance and Functionality
You Can Afford
Built on A&D's cutting-edge sensor technology, the FX-i series is a
highly robust precision balance that delivers fast and accurate weighing
without any frills, offering cost-effective solutions for a diverse array of
applications.
products.features:
Multiple units of measure
You can easily select from: g, oz, lb, lb-oz, ozt, ct, mom, dwt, gr, pcs (counting mode), % (percent mode)
and a user-programmable unit for conversion applications. One additional unit from tl, tol, or N can be
added upon request.
GLP/GMP/GCP/ISO compliant output
For documentation requirements, the balance can output its manufacturer, model, serial number, ID
number, date + time*3, space for signature for calibration report, calibration test report, and title & end
blocks for a series of weighing results. *3 For the FZ-i models only. Please use the AD-8127 compact printer, which
has a calendar function, to print the date and time with the FX-i models.
Statistical calculation function (SCF)
The balance can display and output statistical calculation data including number of data, sum,
maximum, minimum, range (maximum–minimum), average, standard deviation, and coefficient of
variation to facilitate the analysis of measurements.

products.name: FZ-i Series
products.description:
High Performance and Functionality
You Can Afford
Built on A&D's cutting-edge sensor technology, the FZ-i/FX-i series is a
highly robust precision balance that delivers fast and accurate weighing
without any frills, offering cost-effective solutions for a diverse array of

products.features:
Compact footprint: 198 mm × 294 mm
By taking advantage of our Compact Super Hybrid Sensor (C-SHS) technology◆, A&D significantly
reduced the size of a precision balance—25% smaller footprint than our conventional models,
making it ideal for installation and use in confined spaces. ◆ Patented
High-speed weighing with 1-second stabilization
The C-SHS combines the best of magnetic force restoration and single point parallelogram load sensing
technologies. This allows the C-SHS to realize a stabilization speed of just 1 second while maintaining
extremely high span stability. The FZ-i/FX-i series will maximize your productivity and efficiency.
Guarded against accidental overloading◆
An internal shock absorber*1
 protects the C-SHS from the adverse effects of vertical and transverse
overloading. This is especially effective if the balance is embedded in an automated weighing system
where actuator malfunctions are a possibility.
